elements_selected.content: Implement cross-referencing between the link graph and logical theory per REQ-036. Three features: 1) `zetl reason provenance <LITERAL>` — show which documents contribute to a literal's proof, cross-referenced with backlinks between those documents (CON-013 extended), 2) `zetl links <page> --with-conclusions` — for each linked page, show which conclusions that page contributes, 3) `zetl backlinks <page> --with-conclusions` — same for backlinking pages. The --with-conclusions flags are additive enrichments to existing output. Requires both link graph and theory to be computed (full pipeline run).
